flashcard_questions.q: The visual environment created on stage, including scenery, furniture, and spatial arrangement.
A stage design that shows several different locations at the same time, allowing quick transitions between scenes.
A realistic stage design that recreates a single room with three walls and an open fourth wall facing the audience.

flashcard_questions.a: A wheeled platform used to move scenery on and off stage quickly during a performance.
A metal or glass disc placed inside a spotlight to project a pattern or shape onto the stage.
